description: This file defines the LeavePeriodAPI class, which implements CRUD endpoints for managing leave periods within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It provides methods to get current and all leave periods, update leave periods, and handles related validation rules.

classes.name: LeavePeriodAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for managing leave periods, including retrieving current and all leave periods, updating leave periods, and validation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve the current leave period information, including its history and whether it is defined.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all generated leave periods along with current leave period info.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update the start month and day for the leave period, saving the changes and optionally enabling leave menu items.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Not implemented, throws exception if called.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented, throws exception if called.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method, excluding ID parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method, which are empty.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules to validate the startMonth and startDay parameters when updating.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Not implemented, throws exception if called.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented, throws exception if called.
